title: He carried a memory in his wallet as he trudged to
html_source:
A Troilus and Cressida allusion.
Stephen continues his argument that the life Shakespeare led, in this case married to Ann Hathaway, contributed to his writings – he refutes Eglington’s shrew condemnation of Ann and puts her forward as the inspiration for many of Shakespeare’s writings on love.
